name: dsh-project-mcp-manager
description: dsh-project-mcp-manager: per-project MCP server loading for DSH. Reads <projectRoot>/.dsh/mcp.yml (plus read-only Claude Code compat via .mcp.json and ~/.claude.json), mounts each server as an @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client instance with ${VAR} env expansion at mount time, hot-reloads on file change, scopes tool visibility per session, and ships a dsh-mcp CLI for native config management.
author: wldxiaobai <944418001@qq.com>

scripts.test: node test/test-model.mjs && node test/test-mcp-file.mjs && node test/test-cc-file.mjs && node test/test-registry.mjs && node test/test-cli.mjs
